title: Indicator Overload
caption:
Your chart has ten indicators on it. Can you still see the price?

Most indicators come from the same price data, so stacking them often repeats the same signal. And when they disagree, you freeze.

Pick two or three that do different jobs: one for trend, one for momentum, and volume. Meme Street has 49 indicators and free lessons to help you choose.

Practise with fewer, better indicators at memestreet.net

Fictional market. Not investment advice.
